LESSON: WRITING 15.5.1 EMAILS

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade 9
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 15
Topic 15.5: Writing 15.5.1 Emails
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Writing 15.5.1 Emails, part of Strand 15 in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade 9 ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: Why do we write emails? 2. What is the difference between emails and letters?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Writing 15.5.1 Emails together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Communication and collaboration: teamwork skills is enhanced as they share and critique each other’s emails.

• Digital Literacy: information and communication skills as learners exchange emails to their friends.

Values:
• Love: learners read and critique others' reports.

• Unity: learners work in pairs to accomplish tasks.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Safety and security: learners use the internet responsibly when composing and sharing emails.

SECTION 6: SUMMARY

Main points to remember:


Remember the key question: Why do we write emails? 2. What is the difference between emails and letters?

SECTION 7: KICD CURRICULUM REFERENCE (FULL TEXT)
